1 عَكَزَعَلَى عُكَّازَتِهِ , (K,) and عَلَى عَصَاهُ, aor.
عَكُزَ , (A, O,) inf. n. عَكْزٌ and عَكَزَانٌ, (O,) He learned, or stayed himself, (A, O, K,) upon his عُكَّازَة, (K,) and upon his staff; (A, O;) as also ↓ تعكّز : (O, * K:) or this verb signifies he bent himself upon the عُكَّازَة. (O.) ―
-b2- عَكَزَ بِالشَّىْءِ, (IKtt, K,) inf. n. عَكْزٌ, (O,) He used the thing as a leader, or guide; (IKtt;) he guided himself with the thing. (O, * K.) ―
-b3- And He grasped the thing with his fingers. (IKtt.) ―
-b4- عَكَزَ الرُّمْحَ He stuck the spear into the ground. (O, K.) ―
-b5- And عَكَزَهُ He struck him with the عُكَّازَة. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
